title: Implement a deterministic token-bucket rate limiter
prompt: src/ratelimit.py declares TokenBucket, an injectable-clock token bucket rate limiter. Implement it: the bucket holds at most `capacity` tokens, refills continuously at `refill_per_second`, starts full, and allow(cost) consumes tokens only when the whole cost is available. Time never runs backwards; a clock that moves backwards must not create tokens. retry_after(cost) reports the seconds until the given cost would be affordable, 0.0 when it already is. Implement it so the existing test suite passes.
acceptance_criteria: The bucket starts full and never exceeds capacity.
allow(cost) consumes tokens only when the entire cost is available.
Refill is continuous at refill_per_second against the injected clock.
A clock that moves backwards never creates tokens.
retry_after returns 0.0 when affordable, the exact wait when not, and infinity when unreachable.
Invalid capacity, rate, or cost raise ValueError.
